reason: It's brand new, so there are no Play ratings or Reddit threads for me to read, and I don't pay for apps nobody has reviewed. I might try the free tier, but 5 apps is enough for my lists and I make $14k a year, so I'm not paying $6 a month for this.
objection: Will the AI actually build the tracker I asked for, or will I spend my evening fixing what it made? I've had plenty of AI tools give me something close enough that I had to redo it myself.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of solid reviews and Reddit posts from students saying the AI got their apps right the first time, and that they hit the free limit and found Plus worth it.
